title: Affine section realization of formal glueing transition maps
statement: Let A be a commutative local ring, C its maximal-ideal adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and phi:A to C its structural map. Let U be any open of Spec A, let q:Y to U and s:E to Spec C be finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and let D be their supplied overlap identification [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Let f:Fin t to A satisfy D(f_i) contained in U for every i. Set V_i=(q followed by U inclusion) inverse-image D(f_i), O=Y times_U (Spec C restricted to U), and p:O to Y. Give Gamma(E,top) its structural C-action. There exist formal module glueing data X for phi and f [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data], a C-linear equivalence e:X.M' to Gamma(E,top), additive equivalences c_i:M_i to Gamma(Y,V_i), b_ij:(M_j)_(f_i) to Gamma(Y,V_i intersect V_j), and d_i:C tensor_A M_i to Gamma(O,p inverse-image V_i). For every chart element m in M_i, b_ij(alpha_ij(m/1)) is the restriction of c_i(m) to V_i intersect V_j; for every n in M_j, b_ij(n/1) is the restriction of c_j(n) to that intersection. For every prime element m in M', d_i(alpha_i(m/1)) is the restriction of D.toCompleted.appTop(e(m)) to p inverse-image V_i. For every n in M_i, d_i(1 tensor n)=p.app(V_i)(c_i(n)). No cover or H0 compatibility assertion is made.

proof.text: Finiteness of s makes E affine. For each i use Spec_basicOpen, preimage_of_isOpenImmersion with D(f_i) contained in U, and preimage under the finite morphism q to prove V_i affine. Construct transitions from the affine section modules; for t=0 instead construct M′=Gamma(E,top) directly, with every chart field eliminated by Fin.elim0.

The generator section identities imply square and cocycle by the coherence theorem. Build FormalGlueing.Data explicitly from the transition fields and those two proof fields. Keep e,c,b,d from the same transition witness. Its four restriction formulas give the target conjunction unchanged.

theorem exists_affine_chart_realization
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (t : ℕ) (f : Fin t → A)
    (hf : ∀ i, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i) ≤ U) :
    let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let φ := algebraMap A C
    letI : Algebra A C := φ.toAlgebra
    let g : CommRingCat.of C ⟶ Γ(E, ⊤) := (ΓSpecIso (.of C)).inv ≫ s.appTop
    letI : Module C Γ(E, ⊤) := Module.compHom _ g.hom
    let V := fun i ↦ (q ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i)
    let O := pullback q (completionSpecMap A ∣_ U)
    let p : O ⟶ Y := pullback.fst q (completionSpecMap A ∣_ U)
    ∃ (X : FormalGlueing.Data.{u, u, u} φ f) (e : X.M' ≃ₗ[C] Γ(E, ⊤))
      (c : ∀ i, FormalGlueing.piece (f i) (X.M i) ≃+ Γ(Y, V i))
      (b : ∀ i j, FormalGlueing.localize (f i) (FormalGlueing.piece (f j) (X.M j)) ≃+
        Γ(Y, V i ⊓ V j))
      (d : ∀ i, FormalGlueing.extend φ (FormalGlueing.piece (f i) (X.M i)) ≃+
        Γ(O, p ⁻¹ᵁ V i)),
      (∀ i j m, b i j (X.alpha_overlap i j (LocalizedModule.mk m 1)) =
        Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V i)).op (c i m)) ∧
      (∀ i j m, b i j (LocalizedModule.mk m 1) =
        Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j)).op (c j m)) ∧
      (∀ i m, d i (X.alpha i (LocalizedModule.mk m 1)) =
        O.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : p ⁻¹ᵁ V i ≤ ⊤)).op
          (D.toCompleted.appTop (e m))) ∧
      (∀ i m, d i (TensorProduct.tmul A (1 : C) m) = p.app (V i) (c i m))
